description_en: The succession of world powers pictured by the immense image of Daniel 2, the four beasts of Daniel 7 and the ram and goat of Daniel 8: Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece, Rome and Anglo-America, as laid out in NWT Appendix B9. The series ends with the stone cut out of the mountain, God’s Kingdom, established in 1914, which will crush these kingdoms at Armageddon.

sources.quote_en: “The hairy he-goat stands for the king of Greece; and as for the great horn that was between its eyes, it stands for the first king,” the angel Gabriel informs Daniel.
Daniel further recorded that the large horn would be broken and four smaller horns would grow in its place.

sources.quote_en: This description coincides with the time when the seventh head—the Anglo-American World Power—would come to prominence.

symbols.symbol_en: goat with a prominent single horn (“the hairy he-goat”)
great horn: the first king, Alexander the Great
four horns in place of the great horn: four kingdoms of Alexander’s generals

groups.note: The ten horns of the fourth beast picture the kingdoms that grew out of the Roman Empire (“Jehovah Reveals What ‘Must Shortly Take Place,’” w12 6/15, par. 3).

symbols.symbol_en: a horn that grew from the head of a fearsome beast (the “small” horn)
small horn that becomes a fierce-looking king

groups.note: B9 (2013) and w12 6/15 place Anglo-America in the feet of iron and clay; dp (1999) ch. 4 had included it in the iron legs and dated it “from 1763 C.E.”. The newer explanation is used. B9’s picture caption says the ten-horned beast represents “the Roman and Anglo-American World Powers.”

groups.label_en: The stone cut out of the mountain: God’s Kingdom

symbols.symbol_en: a stone cut out of the mountain not by hands, which becomes a large mountain

groups.note: Established in heaven in October 1914; it will crush the kingdoms of the image at Armageddon (dp ch. 4 par. 33-35).

members.label_en: Nebuchadnezzar’s dream of an immense image (Dan. 2)
members.note: Dated 606/605 B.C.E., the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign as world ruler (dp ch. 4 par. 2).

members.label_en: Daniel’s dream of four beasts out of the sea (Dan. 7)
Vision of the ram and the male goat (Dan. 8)
members.note: The vision came “in the third year of the kingship of Belshazzar” (Dan. 8:1); jw.org gives no year for it, so it is anchored to the completion of the book of Daniel (c. 536 B.C.E.).

members.label_en: Babylon
607 B.C.E. King Nebuchadnezzar destroys Jerusalem
539 B.C.E. Medo-Persia conquers Babylon
members.note: dp ch. 4 par. 11: with the death of Belshazzar, the golden head of the image ceased to exist.

members.label_en: Medo-Persia
539 B.C.E. Conquers Babylon
537 B.C.E. Cyrus decrees return of Jews to Jerusalem
members.label_ta: கி.மு. 537-ல் எருசலேமுக்குத் திரும்பிப்போகும்படி யூதர்களுக்கு கோரேஸ் கட்டளை
members.note: The decree record is dated “late 538 or early 537 B.C.E.”; B9 shows 537 B.C.E.

members.label_en: 331 B.C.E. Alexander defeats Darius III at Gaugamela
members.note: dp ch. 4 par. 16: this defeat ended the Medo-Persian World Power, the silver part of the image.

members.label_en: Greece
331 B.C.E. Alexander the Great conquers Persia
The great horn is broken: Alexander dies (323 B.C.E.)
Four kingdoms stand up in place of the great horn (301 B.C.E.)
30 B.C.E. Ptolemaic Egypt, the last Hellenistic kingdom, falls to Rome
members.note: dp ch. 4 par. 20: the copperlike world power continued only until 30 B.C.E.

members.label_en: Rome
members.note: The span record starts in 30 B.C.E. (dp chart “ROME from 30 B.C.E.”); B9 marks 63 B.C.E., when Rome rules over Israel.

members.label_en: 63 B.C.E. Rules over Israel
70 C.E. Destroys Jerusalem
Anglo-America
1914-1918 C.E. During World War I, Anglo-American World Power comes into being
members.label_ta: கி.பி. 1914-1918-ல் முதல் உலகப் போரின்போது, ஆங்கிலோ-அமெரிக்க உலக வல்லரசு உருவாகிறது

members.label_en: October 1914: the Messianic Kingdom “stone” is cut out of the “mountain” of Jehovah’s universal sovereignty
members.label_ta: அக்டோபர் 1914-ல் ‘புறஜாதியாரின் காலம்’ முடிவடைந்தபோது, ‘பரலோகத்தின் தேவன்’ தம் பரலோக ராஜ்யத்தை ஸ்தாபித்தார்.

members.label_en: At Armageddon the “stone” strikes the image on its feet and crushes all these kingdoms
members.label_ta: இந்த அடையாளப்பூர்வ சிலையின் பாதங்களில் கடவுளுடைய பரலோக ராஜ்யம் விரைவில் மோதும்.
members.note: w12 6/15 p. 17 box: Dan. 2:44 refers to the kingdoms pictured by the image; Revelation shows that all other human governments will also be destroyed at Armageddon.

notes: Symbols: metal parts from dp ch. 4 and w12 6/15 (B9 shows them only in its picture); beasts as captioned on B9; Daniel 8 symbols from dp ch. 10 and “Jehovah Is ‘a Revealer of Secrets,’” w12 6/15, par. 12, 15. Pay Attention to Daniel’s Prophecy! (1999) diagram dates the Anglo-American World Power “from 1763 C.E.”; B9 (2013) and w12 6/15 date its emergence to World War I, which is followed here. No chart images are attached to the online dp chapters, so none are recorded.
